title: Bill to keeps the invoice email with the same person, and refuses risky moves
text: The Bill to window in Finance → All Invoices now says who the invoice email goes to, and moving an invoice to another company no longer changes that: an invoice with no person on it keeps going to the same person. An unpaid invoice can no longer be moved into a company that has automatic card payment on, so its saved card cannot be charged by mistake. A moved invoice also takes the new company's test or real status. On the client's payment page, a payer named by the client no longer pulls later parts of a payment plan away from the company, and a loading problem is shown instead of a false "Saved".
points: Finance → All Invoices → the building icon shows who gets the email
Unpaid invoices cannot be moved into a company with automatic card payment on
If a move cannot be completed it is undone, or you are told plainly that it could not be
